title: Audit Search filter visual depth
description: Audit Search for input containment, icon/clear button support, placeholder behavior, debounce, target fields, keyboard behavior, and field binding.
objective: Make Search a configurable filter module instead of a generic text input.
expected_outputs: Target field and compare behavior findings
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers icons, clear button, placeholder, input typography, padding, border, radius, width, and focus state.
The audit checks whether search can target specific fields or only visible text.
The audit identifies debounce/apply-mode implications for auto apply and manual apply.
The audit ties search behavior to field binding and compare/data type.
verification: Source-backed findings cite render, resolver, CSS, JS, and control IDs.
No Search implementation is made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: search audit, render, resolver, frontend runtime

risks: Search can look correct but filter the wrong surface if target field behavior is not explicit.
